opening.argument: The material presents the Forsage marketing plan as member-oriented business guidance built around recruitment-linked returns, including stated percentages of 200%, 580%, and 1200%, bonuses moving to a wallet, and a claimed five-minute cashout. Its structure places sponsored members into hierarchical matrices, with the narration stating, "if you sponsor 2 people then in the matrix you will be like this" and linking additional sponsorship to profit. The slides show BUSD and TRX/USD amounts within those member structures. These features establish the recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix basis of the offer, while the record does not establish that any transfer, sale, payout, or stated percentage was actually achieved.
